extra.final_summary: The data had three issues: (1) two 'sex' labels had extra spaces (' male' and 'male ') which were normalized to 'male'; (2) three 'flipper_length_mm' values were negative (rows 9, 16, 19) and below the minimum allowed (170 mm), so they were excluded; (3) three 'body_mass_g' values were above the maximum allowed (6500 g), so they were excluded. After these fixes, the total body mass for each species was calculated: Adelie: 66,500 g, Chinstrap: 53,225 g, Gentoo: 77,600 g.
